result.title: LungMend: A Healthy-Only Latent Diffusion Shape Prior for Lung Mask Correction in Severe Tuberculosis CT
result.comment: 5 pages (4 + 1 references), 2 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to IEEE ISBI 2027. Code: https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend
result.summary: Lung segmentation models such as R231 are widely used, but they fail on severe tuberculosis (TB) CT: cavities and consolidations look like non-lung tissue and are left out of the mask. We present LungMend, a post-processing model that corrects such masks using only healthy anatomy. A latent diffusion model, trained on healthy lungs with synthetically corrupted masks, learns to recover the complete lung from the faulty mask and the bone anatomy, without any pathological data or CT intensities. LungMend recovers cavities and consolidations that R231 misses and improves accuracy on expert-annotated slices. Code: https://github.com/noureddinekhiati/LungMend

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LungMend：在健康肺解剖上训练 latent diffusion 先验，以带合成损坏的肺掩码和骨骼解剖为条件，作为后处理修复严重结核 CT 中被分割模型漏掉的空洞与实变区域。
AI.relevance_reason: 「用生成先验补回被漏掉的视觉证据、并以人工损坏样本训练恢复」的思路，可能为 LVR 中视觉细节丢失后的 latent 状态补全与监督方式提供可核查线索，但该工作本身是医学分割后处理，与多模态推理无直接联系。
